question: Does the two-intent candidate outperform the live v17 champion when roster, map, seat, and field conditions are matched?

evidence_basis.interpretation: Both policies show concentrated wins under different exposure, so unmatched batches cannot isolate policy quality.

single_change: Replace v17 with v39 on platform-generated matched league fields; no source, prompt, executor, roster, map, seat, or champion mutation.
success_bar: all four matched fields complete for both candidate and baseline
candidate has strictly more wins than baseline
candidate has no fallback, degradation, rejection, unexplained hold, or K1Z harm
candidate replays contain only grow or finish intent markers
failure_bar: candidate wins no more fields than baseline
any identity mismatch or unmatched field
any candidate infrastructure or safety failure

interpretation_boundary.candidate_advantage: Exposure explains part of the automatic-batch gap, but v39 remains killed because it already failed the absolute hosted gate.
interpretation_boundary.tie_or_baseline_advantage: The two-intent candidate is not a better response than v17 on the current matched field; freeze it and mine the strongest opponent and seat failure instead.

authorized_next_action: After same-shell active-player and exact-policy verification, create one four-field platform counterfactual and audit every resulting replay.
